note: THE CONTROL, and the measurement that shrinks this item: three of the four names most reached from `subr-x' are ALREADY kg's. Both sides answer ("a-b" "x" t t) for `string-join', `string-trim', `string-empty-p' and `string-prefix-p'. So what `(require \'subr-x)' costs is the FEATURE plus a short tail of names, not a library -- and in Emacs 31 these names are not even subr-x's own any more: `string-trim' and `string-empty-p' live in subr.el, `string-join' is autoloaded from subr-x, and all of them answer before any require.
